description: The five scripts added by pdfnative 1.8 (add_international_text v1.7.0): Lao (`lo`, dedicated shaper), Tai Tham / Lanna (`nod`) and Cham (`cjm`) through the Universal Shaping Engine, New Tai Lue (`khb`) and Tai Le (`tdd`) — 27 scripts in all. `lang` is an array so each run is routed to the font that covers it, with `latin` for the labels. Fonts are always embedded by this tool, so the PDF/A-2u claim holds under `strict: true`; tagged output also carries /ActualText, which is what lets extract_text return these scripts in logical order. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.
